content:
Sam: Heads up team 1: Sales is asking for an exception on a strategic bundle for NeuralBridge. Ask: 20% off the first-year bundle (inference + optimize) and a one-time onboarding credit of $8k. Reason: anchor customer for our streaming SDK roadmap. Need deal-desk + RevManager approval.

Rhea: Competitor offered 25% + integration support. Customer is lukewarm but engaged. Proposed guardrails: discount applies only to initial 12mo term, no stacking with other promos, onboarding credit capped at $8k and paid as credits against usage, and explicit renewal back to list.

Sam: Quick numbers: ```
Bundle list first-year: $120,000
20% off = $96,000 (delta = -$24,000)
Onboarding credit: $8,000 (applied as usage credits)
Total max concession = $32,000 (one-time)
Note: Sales expects ARR expansion if integrated successfully.
```

Tom: That's a large concession. We need RevManager + Finance sign-off because >$15k. Also require an executive sponsor sign-off and a documented growth milestone (e.g., 3rd-month usage target) to trigger any retention of discounted pricing.

Legal: Drafting language suggestions: label as "limited strategic bundle concession", include non-transferability, no renewal carryover, credit-use rules, and a clause that refunds/credits cannot be converted to cash. Also ask Sales to have customer sign the concession appendix. I can turn around redlines tomorrow.

FinanceBot: Policy: discounts >=15% or concessions >=$15k require Revenue Manager + Finance Director approval and a completed deal-desk form. Upload the deal-desk form and attach the CRM rationale. Internal policy: https://intranet.redwood/finance/deal-desk-policy.

Rhea: I'll add a milestone clause: if customer hits X usage by month 3 (we'll define X in the SOW), then Sales gets cadence to propose a renewal discount; otherwise renewal reverts to list. Also propose a 6-month check-in with Solutions to validate integration.

Sam: Agree. I'll have Sales upload the SOW, the completed deal-desk form, and the partner/customer acknowledgment by 2512350100. Can someone confirm RevManager availability to review today?

RevManager: I can review after 2512350130. Please include the simple financial model and CRM note with "strategic-bundle" tag. If conditions above are in place I'm likely to approve with Exec sponsor sign-off.

Tom: Also request Sales to confirm whether the onboarding credit is refundable if customer churns within 90 days. Prefer it to be non-refundable but recoupable via clawback if they downgrade within 6 months.

Sam: Noted, will ask Sales to include clawback language. Marking thread as deal-desk:pending. :thumbsup:

Rhea: Uploading docs now, will ping when complete.

Sam: Thanks everyone. Let's aim for signed SOW + deal-desk form in the next 90 minutes so RevManager can approve today.
